rubric.current_hypothesis: Measure response markers without treating them as latent confidence.
key_evidence: analyze.py scores initial-answer alias presence on 20 factual items per condition. It detects initial-answer lexical hedging, abstention, clarification and refusal; full-output QA continuation and repeated four-grams (count >=3).
Initial answer ends before the next Q/A role marker; leading A: is removed. Labels may overlap.
Manual audit will cover all 80 neutral nonfactual answers; alias scores are relaxed answer-key retrieval, not whole-response truth.
main_risk: Heuristic markers miss paraphrases and can produce false positives. Exact answer mentions may coexist with false supporting claims. Repetition and entropy do not prove uncertainty.
